## 型

### Response

```emela
type Response(status: Int, headers: List[(String, String)], body: String)
```

A response. The headers of a response received by `send` have lower-case names sorted by name;
values of the same name are joined with `, `, except that each `set-cookie` is its own pair. An
HTTP service sends the headers in the written order.

- `status: Int`
- `headers: List[(String, String)]`
- `body: String`

### UnexpectedStatus

```emela
error UnexpectedStatus(status: Int, body: String)
```

The status is not 2xx (`require_ok`).

- `status: Int`
- `body: String`

## 値

### new

```emela
fn new(status: Int, body: String) -> Response
```

A response with no headers.

### add_header

```emela
fn add_header(res: Response, name: String, value: String) -> Response
```

Adds a header after the ones already in `res`.

### header

```emela
fn header(res: Response, name: String) -> Option[String]
```

The first value of the header `name`, compared without case.

### header_values

```emela
fn header_values(res: Response, name: String) -> List[String]
```

All values of the header `name` in order, compared without case. Not named `headers`, the
field (E0334).

### require_ok

```emela
fn require_ok(res: Response) -> Response fails UnexpectedStatus
```

`res` if its status is 2xx, otherwise fails with UnexpectedStatus.
